summary: The Wetlands are a cold grey marsh below the broken Stonewrought Dam, mist on the ground and mountains on three sides with the open sea on the fourth. Menethil Harbor is the Alliance port here and the sailing point for Kalimdor and Northrend, though the Cataclysm put a good deal of it under water. Dragonmaw orcs hold the Angerfang camp, gnolls the fen and Bluegill murlocs the shallows, night elves keep a grove around the plant-man of local legend, and Grim Batol sits shut at the eastern end.
history: The Wildhammers built their capital at Grim Batol after Ironforge fell out with itself, and left it when the Dark Iron invasion had fouled the mountain past living in; Ironforge later threw the Thandol Span across the canyon to keep the two dwarven countries joined. Doomhammer refused that crossing in the Second War and had his invasion fleet built instead in a hidden anchorage on this coast, goblin shipwrights and troll boatbuilders working under guard, while the Dragonmaw held Grim Batol; the marsh was stripped near bare feeding orcs and dragons. The Alliance took the coast back and rebuilt the yard as Menethil Harbor, named for Lordaeron's king — which is why Ner'zhul's death knights came back to it to steal ships. Freed red dragons broke the Dragonmaw, and the Cataclysm drowned the western marsh.
